## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

content.text: Created file successfully: src/main.js

Need issues:
- `setMode` uses ui.menu etc; at initial manager creation then setMode menu. fine.
- `showEnd` calls setMode('won'/'dead'), which removes? setMode dead doesn't hide end. Then ui.end.classList.remove hidden. okay.
- `die` calls setMode('dead') then setTimeout showEnd. But showEnd calls setMode('dead') again. fine.
- `win` calls setMode('won'), showRadio, setTimeout. fine.
- `updateHUD` in menu calls updateInteract, which state mode menu hides; objective compass if mode !== menu false. okay. It also sets post uniforms. fine.
- `updateHUD` references manager before manager created? animate starts after manager created. Initial setMode after manager. fine.
- `manager` callback onKill uses manager alive count but manager variable assigned before? callback executed later. fine.
- `showEnd` calls setMode then `ui.end.classList.remove`; setMode('dead') doesn't add end, okay. But `setMode('dead')` doesn't hide menu/hud; hud remains. fine.
- `setMode('menu')` hides end. fine.
- `resetGame` calls `manager.reset()` but manager may be null when startGame called? manager initialized at bottom before user can click. fine.
- `resetGame` world.intel.marker visible; okay.
- `world.intel.collected` reset but marker screen.
- `state.exfilActive` reset, world.exfil.active false.
- `state.fade=0`; updateHUD sets uFade=0 then fade increments. good.
- On start, `requestLock` after resetGame. User gesture from deploy click. good.
- `document.pointerLockElement` check in mousemove. If pointer lock fails, state.locked false and no look. Playwright can use debug lookAt. Actual user should work.
- For gameplay if pointer lock denied, impossible to look; could add fallback drag. Later.
- `state.mode='paused'` when pointer lock lost? No, only lockHint. ESC handled. fine.
- On pause, `updateCamera` uses player values; okay.
- On dead/won, updateHUD still calls updateInteract which returns due mode. good.
- `updateHUD` in menu uses player yaw=0 and battery etc; hud hidden. fine.
- Crosshair class hidden in menu; but crosshair has class hidden initial? CSS maybe.
- `ui.crosshair.classList.toggle('hidden', state.mode !== 'playing' || player.dead)` then `die` also adds hidden. On resetGame, we never remove hidden except updateHUD next frame does. okay.
- Damage direction UI.
- `setActiveWeapon` updates HUD; on reset silent sets state.weapon rifle, viewModel visible. good.
- `viewModel.setActive('rifle', true)` but state.weapon already 'rifle'; setActive checks `if (name === this.active) return`, so no issue.
- `state.reloading` false on switch.
- Weapon fire automatic: `state.triggerHeld` true while holding. In update, `fireWeapon` called every frame but fire rate not enforced! Need implement fire cooldown based on rpm. Currently automatic fires every frame (~60/s) with 30 rounds emptying in 0.5s. Must add `state.fireCooldown` and set after shot. Add. Also pending shot checks. Implement:
  - state.fireCooldown=0 in reset.
  - in update decrement.
  - in fireWeapon check `if state.fireCooldown>0 return`, set to 60/w.rpm.
  - pendingShot only fires if cooldown 0; if pending shot and cooldown>0, currently pending cleared even if not fired? We call fireWeapon and it returns; need keep pending? For semi, if click during cooldown, probably ignore. Fine. But auto needs cooldown.
- Need add to state and reset.
- Reload animation viewmodel: state.reloadT starts at duration then decreases. In vm update p = 1 - reloadT/duration, goes 0→1. good.
- `viewModel.setReloading` sets internal reloadT but params used.
- `state.adsBlend` is overwritten to player.ads in updatePlayer. Fire uses. good.
- `player.ads` damp to wantAds. Right mouse down.
- In updatePlayer, `wantAds` uses player.sprinting from previous frame. okay.
- When reloading, wantAds false due `!state.reloading`. good.
- `player.sprinting` computed after wantAds; can sprint while right down? `!wantAds`. good.
- `keys.has('Space')` then deletes, keyup later. okay.
- Jump if not crouch.
- `updateCamera` after updatePlayer. In `fireWeapon`, camera matrix updated. good.
- Player eye `camera.position` includes bob; manager uses it.
- On reset, camera position set.
- Player collision uses `player.position.y` feet; jumping might pass over low crates if feet > 1.3? resolveCircle ignores colliders with maxY < feetY+0.08, so can jump onto? No vertical support; you'll land on floor inside crate if jumped above. Not a big issue; low crates. Could avoid by not using y in collision. But crouch etc. Keep.

- Enemy `onKill` stats.headshots weird. We count stats.headshots on every headshot, not just kills. Fine. The callback line does nothing. okay.
- Kills: manager.kills increments; stats.kills increments callback. End stats uses stats.kills. good.
- `maybeActivateExfil` uses manager.aliveCount; called after kill in updatePlaying. good.
- On collect intel before all dead, maybeActivateExfil false. good.
- `state.clearNotified` only once. fine.
- `state.intelNotified` unused basically.
- `world.intel.collected` true but stats.intel set. good.
- On restart, world.intel.marker mat opacity will update.

- Important: `showEnd` after death calls setMode('dead'), which does `ui.hud.classList.remove('hidden')`, end remains. Fine.
- On pause, `ui.hud` remains. good.
- `setMode('menu')` hides pause/end. good.

- `ui.lockHint` is a div; CSS needed.
- Click on deploy start; ui.controls maybe open. no.
- Escape in menu does nothing.
- End restart `startGame` from button works, pointer lock request maybe from click. good.

- Post render in menu with weaponScene null: post.render handles if weaponScene false. good.

- `post.material.uniforms.uFade` initialized 1; menu fade sets. good.

- Performance: `world.update` each frame loops 700 dust with setY/getY and 42 impacts etc. okay.

- Need add `fireCooldown`.

- Critical bug: `EnemyManager` constructed after `animate`? Actually manager created near bottom before requestAnimationFrame; fine.
- `updateObjectiveHUD` called initial after manager. fine.
- `manager` referenced in `updatePlaying`, not before.

- `world.intel.screenMat` is material; `emissive.setHex` works.
- `world.exfil.active` set each frame.
- `world.exfil.completed` on win.

- `onEnemyShot` effects.muzzleFlash sets global light at enemy muzzle, nice.
- Enemy shots use `ctx.world.raycast` for miss. fine.

- Enemy `raycast` hit spheres head center at 1.82*s but model head center actual: torso y 1.1 + head y .72 + head sphere center maybe 0 = 1.82. yes. Heavy scale 1.1 -> head 2.0. `eyePosition` 1.64*1.1=1.804. fine.
- Body sphere center 1.28, radius .37. okay.

- `world.raycast` includes collider at player's origin? If origin inside a collider, rayAABB may return t=0 and be skipped. Fine.
- `segmentBlocked` uses colliders and y bounds. For container at y 0..2.6, eye y1.8; blocked. For crates 1.2, eye y1.8, not blocked if both endpoints above 1.2? It checks c.maxY < minY+0.02: minY = min eye y ~1.6, c.maxY 1.2 < 1.62 -> skip. Good.
- For enemy eye 1.8 to player eye 1.6, crates skip. good.

- `world.resolveCircle` with player feet y and headY; container maxY2.6, fine. Jumping feet >2.52 could pass through container? not likely.

- `updateCamera` flashlight position adds fwd*.15. fine.
- `viewModel.camera.fov` update projection each frame.

- `effects` flash light at player muzzle: may be very close to camera; okay.

- `world.addImpact` uses `mesh.lookAt(point+normal)`; plane faces +Z by default, lookAt orients +Z toward target. good.

- `addBloodPool` is called on kill callback and on killed immediate; duplicate! In fireWeapon if killed, `world.addBloodPool(e.position)`, and manager onKill callback also `world.addBloodPool(pos)`. Duplicate blood pool. Remove one. Keep callback. Remove in fire. Later.

- Kill feed also duplicate? FireWeapon adds "HOSTILE DOWN" when killed, callback onKill doesn't add. okay.
- `stats.kills` increments in manager callback next frame. good.
- `manager.aliveCount` in maybeActivateExfil: called in updatePlaying after manager.update, so dead. good.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable bodycam-style first-person FPS game, with a visually cohesive tactical mission, HUD, enemies, weapons, objectives, and extraction.

## Requirements
- Build a complete game rather than ask clarifying questions.
- Use reasonable assumptions and mention them briefly in the eventual user-facing completion.
- Check visual output with screenshots and iterate until the scene looks strong.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained Three.js implementation with locally vendored assets.
- Target a gritty bodycam aesthetic: dark warehouse environment, tactical operator viewmodel, harsh HUD overlays, and low-light industrial lighting.
- Include menu, deployment, pause/end states, mission objectives, health, ammo, reload, ADS, weapon switching, enemy AI, and win/death flows.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the core game structure: `index.html`, `styles.css`, and modular `src/*.js`.
- Implemented the Three.js world, warehouse layout, props, materials, textures, lighting, fog, enemies, and objectives.
- Implemented weapon viewmodels, rifle/pistol switching, firing, reload, ADS, muzzle effects, tracers, impacts, and weapon audio hooks.
- Implemented bodycam post-processing, damage vignette, grain, chromatic distortion, HUD, menus, radio text, objective panel, killfeed, and end states.
- Reduced rendering cost and adjusted lighting/materials to improve performance and visual balance.
- Iteratively inspected menu and gameplay screenshots with the browser tooling.

### Active
- Final visual and runtime verification is still in progress.

### Blocked

- Complete and verify a playable bodycam-style first-person FPS with a cohesive tactical mission, combat, objectives, HUD, and extraction.
